_doc: Minimal config for your own pair(s). Keys under 'bases' and 'pairs' are the model names used in row file names (<model>_cap<C>.jsonl.gz). train_cap is the response-length cap the RL run trained with, in tokens; the cap study reads each pair at the smallest shared budget >= train_cap and one budget beyond. Everything else (budgets, benchmarks, views, groups) is optional and derived from the rows when absent; see configs/recipes.json for the full form.
